newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures surge after spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures surge after spot expiry.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures surged across the board on Friday, as a sharply higher spot January contract expiry price triggered active buying of other contracts by local investors, traders said.
The spot January expired midday at 16,260 yen per tonne, up by 1,240 yen from Thursday's close, with 280 lots delivered.
Benchmark November 1997 month was up 180 yen at 13,790. Daily volume was 63,631 lots.
"The spot month's price rally triggered heavy buying in the afternoon. The yen's weaker sentiment against the dollar also encouraged local investors to buy," a brokerage trader said.
